name: KY-008 Laser Transmitter
fullName: KY-008 650nm 5mW Red Dot Laser Diode Transmitter Module
tagline: Co-axial red laser diode emitter for tripwires, targeting, and optical communications
description: The KY-008 laser transmitter module emits a concentrated 650nm red laser beam dot. It consists of a 5mW laser diode housed in a brass cylinder with built-in current limiting resistor. Used for laser tripwire security barriers, optical alignment, and targeting.

pinout.name: 5V Control
pinout.desc: Digital HIGH turns laser ON, LOW turns laser OFF

wiringNote: Do not power laser diodes directly from low-current MCU GPIOs (>12mA) without a switching transistor (2N2222/S8050).
commonMistakes: Pointing directly into human or animal eyes (dangerous eye hazard)
Driving continuous laser power without proper transistor driver
